               <lb n="N005"/>༄༅ || 'di'i rgyu pa ni | yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sargyas 'phags pa <rs type="deity">'jaM dpal</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">slo+on klu grub </rs>| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">zla ba grags pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7788">rig<lb n="N006"/> pa'i khu byug</rs> 
                <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7789">ku su lu che ba</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7790">ku su lu chung ba</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7791">dz+nya na ma ka ra </rs>mnga' ris kyi phyed <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6468">zla ba rgyal mtshan</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8151">rtsang pa rje
